blocks.html: Full Wrap, Partial Wrap, Window Tinting, Lettering, decals, and more..

WHO WE ARE

Vinyl Wrap Toronto began 17 years ago from a customer’s request, born out of creative thinking and a commitment to providing high-quality vehicle wrap services in Etobicoke and the Greater Toronto Area. Since then, we’ve continued to evolve, staying on top of the latest industry techniques and wrapping trends. We’re a full-service vinyl wrap shop with a passion for transforming everyday vehicles into custom masterpieces. From cars and vans to trucks, boats, and even non-vehicle objects, we offer full wraps, partial wraps, decals, custom lettering, and more. With nearly two decades of hands-on experience, we have the confidence to say: if it fits in our garage and has a smooth surface, we can wrap it.

OUR VISION

To deliver top-tier vehicle wrapping services for individuals and businesses looking to customize, protect, and elevate their vehicles.

OUR INSPIRATION

What fuels our work is the reaction we see when clients view their freshly wrapped vehicle. In a world where most vehicles look alike, we offer the opportunity to stand out. At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we understand the desire to be unique—and we’re here to make that happen. We actively spread awareness about the power of vinyl wraps for personal expression and brand visibility. We thrive on challenging projects, having wrapped everything from motorcycles to a 44-foot boat on a trailer—and yes, even urns. It’s that mix of creativity, challenge, and transformation that drives us.

WHY CHOOSE VINYL WRAP TORONTO?

In a competitive GTA market, what sets us apart is our dedication to craftsmanship, customer satisfaction, and clear communication. Our graphic designers work closely with clients to create customized visuals that are then printed on premium vinyl. Our installation team—each with over a decade of experience—executes the wrap with precision and care. No shortcuts, no compromises. We prioritize quality over speed, ensuring each vehicle gets the attention it deserves. We treat your vehicle like it’s our own. And if your vehicle is too large to fit in our facility, we’ll come to you. Flexibility and attention to detail are at the core of what we do.

WHAT’S ON OUR WISHLIST?

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we’re always looking for the next challenge. On our current wishlist:

  • Wrap an Aircraft – Helicopters, planes—bring it on. We’re ready for large-scale aviation wraps.
  • Hockey Locker Room Wrap – We’ve wrapped walls, but we’d love to transform an entire hockey locker room into a visual experience.
  • PWC and Snowmobiles – We’re based in Canada and would love the chance to add snowmobiles and personal watercrafts to our wrapped roster.
  • More Muscle Cars – Muscle cars are made to turn heads. We specialize in customizations that amplify their bold look.
  • More Fleet Vehicles – Fleet advertising is powerful and cost-effective. We’ve done many and would love to do more.

WE LIKE TO MAKE A STATEMENT

Every wrap is an opportunity to push creative boundaries. Whether it’s a commercial fleet or a personal dream car, we pour the same passion and precision into every project. Vehicle wraps are made for people who want to stand out—and that’s exactly the energy we bring to our work.

IF IT’S GOOD ENOUGH FOR US, IT’S GOOD ENOUGH FOR YOU

We use wraps on our own company vehicles, office walls, and promotional items because we believe in the product. Vinyl wraps are a long-lasting, cost-effective form of branding and personalization. Look around—chances are your brand could be showcased in more places than you realize. And when you’re ready, we’re here to make it happen.
